scientific_question: How much DSMC sampling can condition-aware residual field recovery replace while preserving paired T-u accuracy, robustness, physical diagnostics, and end-to-end computational value?

execution_matrix.classical_baseline_order: complete and verify all four budget baselines before launching the 36 new model tasks

classical_baseline_contract.selection_rule: select independently at each budget using development validation targets only

primary_analysis.endpoint: vision_composite_nrmse from the locked MV3 evaluator for T and u
primary_analysis.pairing: same sixteen evaluation seeds; neural errors are first averaged over the three locked training initializations within each evaluation seed
primary_analysis.analysis_scale: natural logarithm of method error divided by paired Raw-at-10 error
primary_analysis.cluster_unit: condition; four evaluation-seed log ratios are averaged within each of the four conditions
primary_analysis.confidence_rule: one-sided 95 percent Student-t upper confidence bound over four condition means, df=3
primary_analysis.decision: noninferior only when the upper confidence bound is at or below log(1.10)
primary_analysis.multiplicity: one primary endpoint; field, profile, condition, and spectral diagnostics are secondary and descriptive

secondary_analysis.bias_floor: report flattening or degradation at large budget as the expected low-budget-method bias regime, without post-hoc exclusion
secondary_analysis.effective_variance_reduction: report both (Raw_at_same_budget/method)^2 and empirical Raw-equivalent budget from the fitted Raw curve

generalization_scope.allowed_claim: locked post-screen budget robustness on four condition pairs absent from model fitting
disallowed_claims: pristine external test after model selection
universal extrapolation over Kn and lid speed
generalization_scope.future_external_test: a new untouched condition or a separately locked leave-one-condition-out study is required for a stronger external-generalization claim

physics_and_failure_diagnostics.naming: condition-aware residual recovery; physics-conditioned is permitted only when conservation and boundary diagnostics are reported prominently
required: T and u field and validated-profile errors
FNO error power spectrum at kn0p1_u400
explicit reporting of profile ratios above one
physics_and_failure_diagnostics.fno_causal_language: spectral and wall-localization diagnostics may support, but do not prove, spectral-bias or periodic-assumption explanations

reproducibility_contract.publish_model_weights: subject to repository or archival size limits
